The song-detail response includes duration, so I will total each playlist’s song durations and compare them to 85 minutes (5,100 seconds) while preserving all 23 library playlists for the final choice.

```python
library_playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    playlist_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not playlist_page:
        break
    library_playlists.extend(playlist_page)
    page_index += 1
playlist_durations = [
    (playlist['title'], sum(song['duration'] for song in playlist['songs']) * 1000),
    for playlist in library_playlists
]
print(playlist_durations)
```
